Using waves 2-7, only variables that are in all of them

```{r}
data <- readRDS("raw_data/Trends_VS_1981_2022_rds_v4_0.rds")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(haven)

data$S002 <- zap_labels(data$s002)

cleaned_data <- data %>%
  filter(as.numeric(s002) != 1)
```

## Figuring out which columns are not present in the waves
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

waves <- 2:7

na_cols_by_wave <- map(waves, function(wave) {
  data %>%
    filter(s002 == wave) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~all(is.na(.)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "all_na") %>%
    filter(all_na == TRUE) %>%
    pull(column)
}) %>%
  set_names(paste0("Wave_", waves))

na_cols_by_wave
```

## Removing columns from data
```{r}
cols_to_remove <- unique(unlist(na_cols_by_wave))
data_cleaned <- data %>%
  select(-all_of(cols_to_remove))

```
